name: n8n_cutover_wave2_lq421_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_CUTOVER_WAVE2_LQ421_20261107 - a registry row at dispatch.mode=live must render into
N8N_RELAY_LIVE_LANES.json with a non-null allowlist live_arg; otherwise n8n_due skips the lane, the
dispatcher writes no run row, and a lane the registry calls live is never run by n8n (the 2026-11-07
wave-2 shape: 21 of the 31 'both' lanes had no dispatch block at all until the 01:25 ET W5 fold 3e5058a4b).
